text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Walking past the training course some
days later, I spot a familiar
figure dashing
down the homestretch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's Silence Suzuka. Her trainer's nowhere
to be seen, so I assume that
she's doing
some solo practice.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... Ah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I rush over to the collapsed Silence
Suzuka
to make sure she's not
hurt.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh... s-sorry. I'm fine,
really. My legs are
just... feeling a bit heavy.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I wonder... Maybe not...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I've been feeling strange ever since my
last
scrimmage race.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It feels as if there's a ball and chain
attached to one of my ankles.
And no
matter how much I run, all I see is
darkness...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Too hard? ...I don't think so. This was
never a problem for me before.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I used to be able to run without a care in
the world. It was everything
to me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But now... What should I do? ...I've never
felt this way before.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I've never felt like... like...
I don't even
want to run...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her expression in no way resembles that
look of pure bliss I am so
used to seeing as
she runs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I fear that she's losing sight of her
ultimate
passion. There has to be
something I can
do...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Phew! A quiet course all to myself...
Running at night is the best.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
And maybe it's just my imagination, but
the stars seem a little brighter
than usual
tonight.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I've got this scenery all to myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it,
she spoke so fondly of
her beautiful view that
evening. Perhaps
Suzuka likes taking in the scenery?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In that case...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Somewhere else?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: A wonderful view...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Is there really such a place near the
academy? I feel like I'm quite
used to all
the sights around here...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Will you really?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately,
I have just the place in mind.
The surroundings are awash with lush
greenery, and there is plenty of wide-open
space to run.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Wow...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The sky cleared up while we were on the
train. There's so much
greenery, bathing in
sunlight... It's beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
And this path here... Just where does it
lead?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Good idea. I'll be back soon!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... Phew.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (My legs still feel a bit heavy. But...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...What a nice breeze. It's so cool and
refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Okay... I think I'll run a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(The feeling of kicking up dirt with my
feet... My body getting hot...
The cool
breeze...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(This is it. This feeling... Running like
this...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (This is my ideal scenery...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Absolute silence. With only the sounds of
the wind and my own
beating heart. This
world is mine...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: And mine alone!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... Phew.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very.
It's been a while since I've been
able to just run without a
care.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you... It made me remember...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I loved running like this even when I was
little. One day, my parents
encouraged me
to try running in a race.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
As long as I was running, I was happy,
so I
agreed to the race... But...
it was really
tough at first.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I was surrounded by other children...
It was
noisy, and I felt trapped.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So I ran... all the way to the front,
where
there was nobody but me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I needed to go somewhere away from
the others, where they wouldn't be able to
catch up with me. So I ran as fast as I
could... and suddenly everything opened
up in front of me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It was... quiet. And I was alone.
I reached a
place nobody else could.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I... need to run in the lead.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I need to reach that place,
even if it's
just once more! I don't care
about anything
else!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I think I should tell my trainer exactly
how
I feel. That I can't run if I'm
not in the
front.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um... So maybe... Would you...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind accompanying me when I
tell her? I'm not very good
at speaking,
you see...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: S-so, please come with me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we return to the academy to talk
to Silence Suzuka's trainer...
